content.text: Prompt identification and discontinuation of the causative and suspected drug(s) (taken within 6 weeks before onset) = critical
Stop culprit and cross-reactive drugs; avoid empiric antibiotics, analgesics or any other drugs as much as possible in the acute and subacute phases

meta.title: Stop the culprit drug; avoid nonessential drugs
